description: Defines classes, structures, constants, and function declarations for managing HTTP network sessions in Chromium, including session parameters, context, and session management.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSessionParams
classes.description: Holds configuration options for HttpNetworkSession, such as HTTP/2, QUIC, and SPDY settings.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSessionContext
classes.description: Contains pointers to dependencies required by HttpNetworkSession, all outlive the session.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSession
classes.description: Manages network session objects used by HttpNetworkTransaction, including socket pools, SPDY sessions, and QUIC sessions.

methods.name: HttpNetworkSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with parameters and context.

methods.name: http_auth_cache
methods.description: Returns pointer to the HTTP auth cache.

methods.name: ssl_client_context
methods.description: Returns pointer to the SSL client context.

methods.name: GetSocketPool
methods.description: Returns socket pool for specified type and proxy.

methods.name: SocketPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Creates a Value summary of socket pool state.

methods.name: SpdySessionPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Creates a Value summary of SPDY session state.

methods.name: QuicInfoToValue
methods.description: Creates a Value summary of QUIC session state.

methods.name: CloseAllConnections
methods.description: Closes all network connections with specified error.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Returns the session parameters used during construction.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Returns the session context used during construction.

methods.name: IsQuicEnabled
methods.description: Checks if QUIC is enabled for new streams.

methods.name: SetEnableQuic
methods.description: Enables or disables QUIC (if Cobalt customizations enabled).

methods.name: SetEnableHttp2
methods.description: Enables or disables HTTP/2 (if Cobalt customizations enabled).

methods.name: UseQuicForUnknownOrigin
methods.description: Checks if QUIC should be used for unknown origins (if Cobalt customizations enabled).

methods.name: CreateCommonConnectJobParams
methods.description: Creates connection parameters for network jobs.

methods.name: SetConnectionOptions
methods.description: Sets QUIC connection options (if Cobalt customizations enabled).

methods.name: SetClientConnectionOptions
methods.description: Sets client QUIC connection options (if Cobalt customizations enabled).
